question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

Caves like Ajanta lie in __perpetual__ darkness.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Permanent**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Perpetual **means continuing indefinitely, never-ending, or occurring repeatedly over time. (**लगातार**)

 
 
• **Example**: *The perpetual motion of the planets in the solar system has fascinated astronomers for centuries.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Permanent **means lasting or intended to last indefinitely, not temporary. (**स्थायी**)
 
 
• **Example**: *The ink used in this document is permanent; it will not fade over time.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Extreme: **Reaching a high degree, far beyond the ordinary or average. (**चरम**)
 
• **Brief: **Lasting for a short duration, concise in time or length. (**संक्षिप्त**)
 
• **Huge: **Extremely large in size or amount. (**विशाल**)
